title: Xiaomi's Humanoid Robots Just Worked a Full 8-Hour Factory Shift
description:
Xiaomi says its humanoid robots worked a full 8-hour shift (8 h 05 min) in the final assembly workshop of its EV factory, sorting centre-console side covers.
In the sped-up video they recharge twice and a wheeled robot picks up a dropped part, but Xiaomi hasn't said how often humans stepped in.
